body_lead: The world is standing at the edge of a technological transformation that will redefine how societies secure trust, investigate wrongdoing, and uphold justice. For decades, forensic science has relied on physical traces such as fingerprints, DNA, ballistic evidence and, more recently, digital logs and cyber trails. But the rise of Artificial Intelligence and quantum technologies is changing the very terrain on which investigators operate. AI is no longer just a tool for automation; it is reshaping how evidence is generated, manipulated, and interpreted.
